purpose: Compare the two outcome-blind NSESche Pareto guards frozen before V73 against a fresh same-seed frozen FaaSRank cohort, after V74 independently proved exact faithful-initializer fidelity.

source.V74_fidelity_finding: The repaired faithful anchor exactly matched frozen FaaSRank on all gated fields for all ten E430-E439 seeds. No candidate runs were executed and no V73 candidate summary was opened.

mechanism_scope.faithful_initializer: The exact frozen FaaSRank epsilon=0.1 sequential decision path with immediate 256-entry rolling-history truncation proved in V74.
mechanism_scope.score_pareto_rule: A post-initialization move requires strict paper-utility improvement and strict frozen FaaSRank exploitation-score improvement.
mechanism_scope.completion_pareto_rule: A post-initialization move requires strict paper-utility improvement, strict outcome-blind completion-proxy improvement and nonworse frozen FaaSRank exploitation score.

result_blind_execution_order: Commit and push this plan before generating any E440-E449 run spec, tape or output.
Generate exactly three ten-run manifests from one fresh source: frozen FaaSRank, score Pareto and completion Pareto.
Capture ten base tapes once, derive ten scale5 tapes and bind identical per-seed hashes to all three manifests.
Bind the same frozen FaaSRank model payload to all three arms and build exactly twenty NSESche references before online execution.
Run FaaSRank first, score Pareto second and completion Pareto third, strictly serially without reading intermediate performance.
Require thirty attempt-one QC passes, zero quarantine, exact three-way pairing and one runtime identity before opening summaries exactly once.

analysis.throughput: Arithmetic mean fixed-window throughput across ten paired seeds.
analysis.qpr_finite_only: Arithmetic mean per-run fixed-window throughput/(mean completed-request latency*cost) across finite paired runs.
analysis.qpr_zero_completed_as_zero: The same QPR with zero-completion or nonfinite-denominator runs contributing zero over all ten seeds.
analysis.candidate_gate: A selection candidate mean must strictly exceed the same-seed FaaSRank mean for throughput, finite-only QPR and zero-as-zero QPR. A tie on any metric fails.
analysis.selection_rule: If both candidates pass all three strict mean gates, select the candidate with the larger minimum relative improvement across the three metrics. An exact tie fails and selects neither.
analysis.paired_uncertainty: Report paired candidate-minus-FaaSRank differences and BCa 95 percent confidence intervals without changing the gate.
analysis.success_action: Freeze the selected profile and preregister a separate twenty-seed confirmation beginning at E450.
analysis.failure_action: Retain the complete V75 cohort. Select neither candidate; do not relax a gate, switch using a subgroup or reuse E440-E449 for further tuning.
